_source: Badge files already in assets/badge/ that the recovered BADGES registry never listed
_note: The registry maps a club name to { match, src, alt, aspect }. `match` is the lowercase needle oppBadge() falls back to when the full club name does not match exactly, so a fixture listed under a slightly different spelling still resolves. Kingsmeadow United's crest was supplied by the club as a flat white square; the white is knocked back to transparent so it sits on the dark card like every other badge.
_deny: A needle matches anywhere in a club's name, so a short one claims clubs it has nothing to do with: the Brian Howard President's Cup draw of 16 September 2026 put Balham & Clapham Albion, Dynamo Putney FC and Club Internacional de Fútbol Clapham in the same competition as us, and they resolved to the Balham Bteckerz, Dynamo London and Clapham Chiefs crests. `deny` names the clubs an entry's needle must never answer for. It is a judgement about who is who, so it is a list somebody writes, not a rule to be guessed; an exact name in the registry still wins, so supplying a club's own crest retires its entry here.
